findings.missingOrIncorrectBehavior: Returns empty object {}. Computes no pressure Laplacian, Jameson-Schmidt-Turkel sensor, or Mach divergence.

findings.missingOrIncorrectBehavior: Returns {isValid: true} unconditionally. Ignores inverted cells, zero volume cells, extreme aspect ratios, and severe non-orthogonality.

findings.duplicateElsewhere: Fvm3DMeshGenerator.auditMeshQuality and CfdMeshQualityValidator in src/engine/cfd3d/mesh/ calculate exact skewness, aspect ratios, and volumes.

findings.missingOrIncorrectBehavior: Claims convergence immediately (isConverged: true, maxResidual: 0) on iteration 1 without calculating L2 or Linf norms of continuity or momentum equations.
findings.reproducibleTestProof: Allows completely unconverged flow fields to exit as successfully solved.
findings.duplicateElsewhere: ResidualEngine.ts and Fvm3DNavierStokesSolver evaluate raw residuals, but monitor abstraction was bypassed.
findings.recommendedNextAction: Implement normalized L2 residual tracking ||Ax - b|| / ||b|| with sliding window convergence criteria.
